# Janki Nath & Co. (JNC Fabrics)

> Fourth-generation woven fabric manufacturer and exporter from Mayapuri, New Delhi, India. Established 1968. Cotton, linen, jacquard, viscose, dobby, yarn-dyed, crepe, twill and upholstery fabrics. BCI, GOTS, OCS and OEKO-TEX Standard 100 certified. Mill-direct export to fashion brands, garment manufacturers and buying houses across 20+ countries.

## Products

- [Cotton Fabric](https://jcofabrics.com/fabrics/cotton) — Plain weave, twill, poplin, canvas, dobby. BCI and GOTS certified. Greige, RFD, dyed and printed finishes.
- [Linen Fabric](https://jcofabrics.com/fabrics/linen) — 100% linen and linen blends. Cotton/linen, viscose/linen. GOTS and OCS certified.
- [Jacquard Fabric](https://jcofabrics.com/fabrics/jacquard) — Damask, brocade, matelassé, cutwork. Custom pattern development.
- [Yarn-Dyed Fabric](https://jcofabrics.com/fabrics/yarn-dyed) — Checks, stripes, plaids, madras. BCI certified cotton.
- [Upholstery Fabric](https://jcofabrics.com/fabrics/upholstery) — Sofa fabric, curtain fabric, drapery. OEKO-TEX certified.
- [Viscose Fabric](https://jcofabrics.com/fabrics/viscose) — Viscose twill, crepe, plain. Fluid drape for fashion brands.
- [Dobby Fabric](https://jcofabrics.com/fabrics/dobby) — Self-dobby and colour dobby. Premium shirting.
- [Crepe Fabric](https://jcofabrics.com/fabrics/crepe) — Moss crepe, high twist, georgette weight.
- [Twill Fabric](https://jcofabrics.com/fabrics/twill) — Cotton twill, drill, gabardine for workwear and trousers.
- [Indigo Fabric](https://jcofabrics.com/fabrics/indigo) — Traditional indigo dyed woven fabric.
- [Lurex Fabric](https://jcofabrics.com/fabrics/lurex) — Metallic woven fabric for evening wear.
- [IKAT Fabric](https://jcofabrics.com/fabrics/ikat) — Traditional resist-dyed patterns.
- [Lycra Blends](https://jcofabrics.com/fabrics/lycra-blends) — Stretch woven fabric, 2-way and 4-way stretch.
- [Certified Fabrics](https://jcofabrics.com/fabrics/certified) — BCI, GOTS and OCS certified fabric range.

## Certifications

- BCI (Better Cotton Initiative) — responsible cotton farming
- GOTS (Global Organic Textile Standard) — full organic supply chain
- OCS (Organic Content Standard) — organic content verification
- OEKO-TEX Standard 100 — product safety testing

## Manufacturing

Weaving units: Meerut (Uttar Pradesh), Bhiwandi/Ichalkaranji (Maharashtra), Erode (Tamil Nadu), Salem (Tamil Nadu), Surat (Gujarat)

Head office and showroom: A-14, Mayapuri Industrial Area, Phase-1, New Delhi 110064, India

## Export Markets

USA, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Belgium, Switzerland, Japan, South Korea, Australia, New Zealand, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Canada, Scandinavia
